train_and_test: run the full training and validation loop for Stable Diffusion 3D finetuning with cross-frame attention
update_model: update the UNet architecture by replacing self-attention with cross-frame attention layers for multi-view conditioning
train_step: train the model on a batch of multi-view images with optional dreambooth prior preservation loss
test_step: test the model by running inference on a validation batch and computing PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS metrics
run_train_cli: run the training pipeline via CLI using tyro argument parsing with CO3D dataset and finetune configs
